findings.title: Treatment With 9-mg Mazdutide for Weight Reduction in Chinese Adults With Obesity: The GLORY-2 Randomized Clinical Trial (JAMA)
findings.whatChanged: New phase 3 readout at the higher 9 mg dose. Dossier cites NMPA approvals but not GLORY-2. Mean body-weight change -16.65% (95% CI -18.19 to -15.12) vs -1.50% placebo at week 60; 84.3% vs 33.1% achieved >=5% loss; n=461. DOI 10.1001/jama.2026.8142, NCT06164873.
